Module Contents

.. py:function:: display_monthly_arrival_delay_graph(departure_station: str, arrival_station: str, start_month: int, end_month: int, selected_years: list[int], actual_year: int = 2026) -> None

   Display a graph of monthly mean arrival delays
   for a selected railway line.

   Compare the monthly mean delays of the actual year with
   the median of the monthly mean delays from selected previous years.

   The graph also displays historical minimum, maximum and quartiles,
   when enough observations are available.
   The months selected by the user are highlighted.

   :param departure_station: departure railway station
   :type departure_station: str
   :param arrival_station: arrival railway station
   :type arrival_station: str
   :param start_month: first month of the selected period (included)
   :type start_month: int
   :param end_month: last month of the selected period (included)
   :type end_month: int
   :param selected_years: years selected by the user.
                          The actual year wil be excluded from historical calculations if needed.
   :type selected_years: list[int]
   :param actual_year: year whose observations are compared
                       with the historical distribution. Defaults to 2026.
   :type actual_year: int, optional
